country.evidence_quote: The company is a small, independent family owned and operated enterprise which started in Mike Collins’ garage in 1992. Today, Advantage operates in an 18,000 square foot factory based in Santa Ana, California and is a family affair with Lyann and their son, Eben managing the business with Mike. Advantage owns its own tooling and proudly produces their products here in the USA.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Advantage manufactures Portable Commercial Pool Vacuums and Pool Service Carts, commercial and residential pool, pond and spa pumps, motors, cartridge & sand filters and related equipment. Primarily selling to Maintenance Pros and Repair Professionals, Advantage products are available through a network of resellers and Distributors Nationwide such as Leslie’s and Doheny’s.
